**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic loss-of-function variants in ERCC5 in individuals with Xeroderma Pigmentosum group G but without any features of facial dysmorphism-immunodeficiency-livedo-short stature syndrome, or vice versa, would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: The presence of common ERCC5 variants (AF > 0.1%) in gnomAD that are not associated with either disease would also weaken the hypothesis.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of ERCC5 and the NER pathway in these distinct disease entities could reveal novel therapeutic targets for DNA repair enhancement or modulation of downstream consequences of genomic instability, potentially benefiting patients with either condition.
